text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black seized victory in the 
Kikuka-sho. The defeated Duramente stood 
stunned on the turf for a long while...

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
After the race, she remarked that Kitasan 
Black had shown strength like a completely 
different person, but swore that she would 
definitely get her revenge someday.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
After that, they decided her next race 
would be the Nakayama Kinen. It was a 
choice made with the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe in mind.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
On the way home that day, Fuji Kiseki 
called out to the Trainer. She remarked 
that Duramente, who captivates so many 
people with her overwhelming running, was 
just like a stage actor.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I want you to give so many 
people dreams— Hearing a wish different 
from her clan's expectations, Duramente 
found a renewed resolve. Next up was the 
Nakayama Kinen."
